messages:
frank: quick sync  we need to lock the April milestone scope today. two paths: narrow MVP or add a short freeze. thoughts?
ivy: what are the top risky items right now?
frank: list from the spec: 1) per-tenant model-pinning UI polish, 2) embedding cache warm dashboard, 3) admin bulk CSV import/export, 4) live request tracing toggle. small: latency probe.
nora: customers want CSV import/export but we can make it async to shrink test matrix. pinning UI and warm dashboard -> defer to v1.
sam: agree. If export is async + whitelist + audit, MVP gives customers value with low blast radius. We should also include the trace toggle and latency probe.
ivy: security conditions: S3 expiring link, RBAC check, audit event, and retention rules. Can devs scope that to read-only export with 24h expiry?
nora: yes, estimate 3 dev days + 2 QA days for async export + audit. With infra reduced week-of-4/6 we should add a +5 day freeze to allow full regression.
qa-bot: QA ticket QA-6002 opened. Checklist: smoke, RBAC regression, export integrity, audit verification, expiry validation.
release-bot: milestone "2026-04-ship" updated: freeze +5 days, canary staged (3% -> 20% -> 80% -> 100%), rollback target set to last-stable. :white_check_mark:
frank: decision: MVP = async admin export (beta-flagged & whitelisted) + trace toggle + latency probe. v1 = pinning UI + warm dashboard. Action owners: @nora spec + PR; @ivy request security ack; @sam add feature-flag & whitelist; @frank update customer comms. Reconvene 10am PT.
ivy: i'll file SEC review and add reviewers.
frank: thanks all. if anyone objects, speak now. :thumbsup:
